days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Monte Perdido
stops.detail: Its altitude ranges between 700 m above sea level at the Bellós river and 3348 m above sea level at Monte Perdido.

stops.name: macizo de las Tres Sorores
stops.detail: The orography of the park is dominated by the Tres Sorores massif, Treserols, the highest limestone massif in Europe.

days.title: Eastern and Peripheral Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: valle de Pineta
stops.detail: The basic morphology of the park is due to two orogenies, but mainly to the Alpine folding and elevation of the Tertiary era, later molded by glacial erosion during the Quaternary era, giving rise to a series of very defined glacial circles and valleys, such as the Ordesa valley and the Pineta valley.

stops.name: valle de Bujaruelo
stops.detail: Likewise, although it does not belong to the central zone of the park but to its peripheral zone, the Bujaruelo valley in the western area is worth highlighting.
